items.title: William Ballariel Interview, 1959-10-02
items.q: this Alec Pope, this, uh, John Pope's father, he organized Excelsa Band.

ctx.x: You were telling us the band had been called the Creole Band at first?

It was called the Creole Band years ago. That's what I learned from the old folks, you know. Uh-huh. And then, uh, with this little disagreement, uh, this Alec Pope, this, uh, John Pope's father, he organized Excelsa Band. Uh-huh. And then, let's say, he got some of the fellas to pull with him and he organized an Excelsa Band. Uh-huh. And then the Excelsa Band, uh, with, uh, with, uh, the old Creole Band, it, it lived, uh, around, I guess, around 70 years, you see. Yeah. Yeah. And I joined it, oh, let's see, when…
I was going to ask, I don't even know which instruments you played or if you played more than one.
